name: ownership
fault_schedule: A acknowledges; B and D reserve then pause before open; C supersedes and acknowledges; B then D resume separately, each fences C, fails readiness, retires; fresh C reservation recovers after each. Captured read pauses before barrier until successor opens.
assertions: Reservation and Owner reject mismatched directory/data prefix/store bindings.
Owner admission blocks reads until held gate releases.
Stale captured read cannot pass unique nonempty durable authority barrier.
Two finite delayed openers retire after rejected READY CAS; fresh owner recovers acknowledged state and progress.
